title: Power Rankings: Mavs are first for second week
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 17

rankings.summaryHtml: Friendly advice: If you want to keep the No. 1 ranking, Dallas, I'd avoid spotting Spurs a lead of 19 or 24, both of which Mavs overcame to beat Grizz and Raps.
